epic.title: EPIC-005: Dashboard — Category Views & Actions Center
epic.description: L'utilisateur analyse chaque catégorie en détail et voit les zones d'amélioration avec Priority Source Targets. Story 5.1: Category View — Perception Summary & KPI Cards. Story 5.1b: Category View — Brand Prioritization Matrix. Story 5.1c: Category View — Brand Rankings. Story 5.2: Category View — Unified Questions Table. Story 5.3: Category View — Perception Topics & Citation Sources. Story 5.4: Actions Center — Visibility Improvements Display. Story 5.4b: Actions Center — Competitive Improvements Display. Story 5.4c: Actions Center — Reputation Improvements Display. Story 5.5: Actions Center — Priority Source Targets & Detail Panel.

stories.title: [Story 5.1] Category View — Perception Summary & KPI Cards
stories.description: As an Editor I want to see category-specific perception summary and KPIs So that I can assess performance within each category.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an Editor navigating to a category view, When the view loads, Then it shows: per-category AI Perception Summary with key insight, 5 KPI cards (same metrics scoped to category), all respect market/LLM filters

stories.title: [Story 5.1b] Category View — Brand Prioritization Matrix
stories.description: As an Editor I want to see a brand matrix scoped to a category So that I can identify brand positioning within the category.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an Editor on a category view, When the matrix loads, Then it shows Brand Prioritization Matrix (brands as data points, scoped to category), respects market/LLM filters

stories.title: [Story 5.1c] Category View — Brand Rankings
stories.description: As an Editor I want to see brand rankings scoped to a category So that I can see who leads in this category.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an Editor on a category view, When rankings load, Then it shows Brand Rankings table scoped to category, respects market/LLM filters

stories.title: [Story 5.2] Category View — Unified Questions Table
stories.description: As an Editor I want to see all questions for a category with per-LLM responses and favorability So that I can understand exactly how each AI engine answers.
acceptanceCriteria: Questions table grouped by type (Visibility/Competitive/Perception) with per-LLM responses and favorability rules
Filtering by favorability (Favorable/Split/Not Favorable) combinable with question type
Expanding questions shows full ranking lists, win/loss per LLM, cited sources, and full LLM response text

stories.title: [Story 5.3] Category View — Perception Topics & Citation Sources
stories.description: As an Editor I want to see perception topics and citation sources per category So that I can understand reputation themes and source landscape for each category.
acceptanceCriteria: Perception topics with sentiment filtering (All/Positive/Mixed/Negative) and LLM attribution badges
Citation sources including perception-related sources and reputation gaps
Source detail showing full URL, page title, normalized domain, and which LLM(s) cited it
stories.notes: Perception summary and concepts should be created from all response types (perception, visibility, competitive) not just perception

stories.title: [Story 5.4] Actions Center — Visibility Improvements Display
stories.description: As an Editor I want to see visibility-related improvement areas So that I know where my brand is underperforming in AI search.

stories.title: [Story 5.4b] Actions Center — Competitive Improvements Display
stories.description: As an Editor I want to see competitive improvement areas So that I know where competitors are winning.
acceptanceCriteria: Improvements scoped to selected market when filter applied

stories.title: [Story 5.4c] Actions Center — Reputation Improvements Display
stories.description: As an Editor I want to see reputation improvement areas So that I know where sentiment is negative.
improvementTypes: negative_sentiment (max 3 per category, highest severity first)

stories.title: [Story 5.5] Actions Center — Priority Source Targets & Detail Panel
stories.description: As an Editor I want to expand improvement areas and see priority source targets So that I have a concrete outreach plan for PR actions.
detailPanelSections: Quick Stats (relevant KPIs for the issue)
Priority Source Targets (third-party domains with favorability, citation count, gap count)
prioritySourceFields: gaps count (questions where brand underperforms and domain is cited)
